I’m sorry you’re carrying this alone. Missing your wife and still having sexual needs can both be true—one doesn’t cancel out the other, and it doesn’t mean you loved her any less.

If you mean **adult videos**, here are safer, private ways to approach it:

- Use your **own phone/computer**, not a shared family device.
- Use **private/incognito browsing**, but know it doesn’t hide activity from your internet provider or the device owner.
- Consider a **VPN** if privacy is a major concern.
- Avoid clicking pop-ups or downloading files—many adult sites can have scams or malware.
- Don’t enter credit card details unless it’s a trustworthy, legitimate service.
- Keep it private from your children; you don’t need to explain your private life to them.

Also, if this is tied up with grief or loneliness, you might consider a widowers’ support group, counselor, or even a discreet dating/companionship app when you feel ready. Wanting comfort after loss is human.
